qckn_claim_boundary: Uses QCKN V1 developmental discipline; does not claim the Stage 1 benchmark is itself a realization of the QCK finite-linear theorem surface.

protected_consequences: Submission.impl has the required type for its problem.
Submission.impl_correct proves equality to the fixed specification for every input.
The submission passes the challenge axiom/restriction checks.
The measured candidate bytes are identical to the proof-checked candidate bytes.
The candidate passes canonical challenge acceptance.
Only rule-compliant general algorithms and representations are eligible for promotion.

authority.correctness_primary: Lean 4.33.1 kernel under the pinned challenge environment
authority.canonical_acceptance: SAIR Lean Kernel Challenge evaluator at rules commit 940f0a2ead23ef70ab1387edabb347e629111edd
authority.development_cost_proxy: Callgrind Ir, 3 repetitions per public endpoint, summed medians
authority.official_rank_authority: Linux PERF_COUNT_HW_INSTRUCTIONS on the official Stage 1 PMU evaluator
authority.note: Callgrind/wall results never imply official leaderboard rank.

resource_envelope.development_policy: Prefer lower protected Callgrind total; use wall only as a screening metric.

promotion_gate: negative or falsifying control where applicable
paired resource measurement against protected champion
strict resource improvement for local promotion
future_obligations: Re-evaluate on a new cohort if the official toolchain, input policy, metric, or evaluator changes.
Do not transfer an optimization rule across problems without independent target-specific verification.
Preserve prior champions so any claimed warm advantage can be ablated back to a cold baseline.
